title: 低卡路里蛋糕选择
problem_statement_md:
一家当地的面包店有各种不同的蛋糕。

具体在蛋糕表**cakes**中，数据如下：

![](/content/assets/05d19d98825c9efcf6ac.jpeg)

列字段备注:
- `name`: 蛋糕名
- `calories`: 热量卡路里，int类型

今天，一个客户想要卡路里最低的蛋糕。
写一个查询，按卡路里对蛋糕排序，并选择前3个蛋糕提供给顾客。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Cakes[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

A local bakery creates unique cake sets. Each cake set contains three different cakes.
Here is the [b]cakes[/b] table: [img id="4530" width="100%"]Тoday a customer want a cake set that has minimal calories.
Write a query to sort the cakes by calorie count and select the first 3 cakes from the list  to offer the customer.
[note]Try to combine [b]ORDER BY[/b] and [b]LIMIT[/b] keywords.[/note]
hint_md: 尝试将**ORDER BY**和**LIMIT**这两个关键词结合起来。

code_templates.solution_code: select * from cakes order by calories limit 3;
code_templates.prepend_code:
